title: Recursion Basics Quiz
description: A quick check to review the basic idea of recursion.

options.text: A function calling itself to solve a smaller version of a problem
A way to permanently delete a list
A Python keyword for sorting numbers
A loop that must always use range()

questions.explanation: Recursion happens when a function calls itself, usually with a smaller input.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following code?
questions.codeSnippet:
def countdown(n):
    if n == 0:
        print("Done")
        return
    print(n)
    countdown(n - 1)

countdown(2)
questions.explanation: The function prints 2, then calls countdown(1), then prints 1, then reaches countdown(0) and prints Done.
